title: Consistent global configuration and scripting options
detail: **Missing/partial; specified.** Root options do not provide global `--config`, `--json`, `--non-interactive`, or policy selection. Equivalent controls are scattered among commands.

title: Stable machine-output API
detail: **Partial.** Successful commands often support JSON; failures, envelope/schema, exit details, and event output are inconsistent. F06/F07/F10 demonstrate the consequences.

title: Regression policies for CI
detail: **Partial.** Absolute release gates and compatible run deltas exist. `compare` exits for compatibility/coverage, not a configured degradation in score, latency, or cost. Add predeclared regression tolerances and fail rules.

title: Complete case-result export
detail: **Partial.** Report JSON contains summaries and non-passing evidence. There is no general headless export of every passing/failing case and repetition to JSONL/CSV, with explicit content controls.

title: CI report adapters
detail: **Missing.** Benchmark-result JUnit/SARIF-style exports are absent. The repository's pytest JUnit files are test evidence, not a user feature.

title: Named baselines, tags, and searchable run history
detail: **Partial.** Run IDs, status filters, and a limit exist. Baseline aliases, run tags/notes, metadata search, pagination, and promotion of an approved baseline are missing.

title: Convenient bounded run controls
detail: **Partial.** Plans support selection, repeats, concurrency, retries, timeouts, budgets, caches, and quotas. `run` largely requires editing a plan file. Add validated direct overrides and a dry-run that prints the exact frozen scope.

title: Reproducibility controls and provenance
detail: **Partial.** Selection/bootstrap seeds and frozen configuration exist. The run CLI does not expose the engine's `run_seed`; local source/dependency/commit provenance is incomplete, as F04 shows.

title: Release gates in conversation drafts
detail: **Missing; documented limitation.** Gates can be authored in executable plans but not declared through session draft choices/patches.

title: Retry only failed application work
detail: **Implemented.** `runs retry` creates a bounded child from safe final application failures or explicit parent-scoped cases on finished runs; it rechecks current/frozen policy and dataset/test-world identity, and records parent lineage.

title: Headless run supervision
detail: **Implemented.** **run --detach** and **resume --detach** launch supervised workers with workspace logs; **runs control RUN_ID pause|resume|cancel** and **resume RUN_ID** send sequenced durable requests, offline cancellation finalizes without dispatch, and **runs status** distinguishes the detached process from the current lease owner.

title: Configuration management
detail: **Implemented.** `config show/validate/set` reports effective values and source precedence, validates schemas before atomic edits, and redacts secret-like values. `config profiles add/list/show/use/remove` manages validated per-user provider profiles used by chat and model planning.

title: Structured progress and durable logs
detail: **Implemented.** `run`, `resume`, and `runs retry` support append-only JSONL event logs plus verbosity/quiet controls. `runs events` reads or follows versioned events with cursors. Cross-process log locks protect event order; noninteractive behavior is documented. See `implementation/G13.md`.

title: Warmup and measurement phases
detail: **Implemented.** Bounded plan `warmup_repetitions` and `run --warmup-repetitions`; warmup application calls run before measured calls, consume application budget/quota/cost, bypass cache, produce no metric work, and are excluded from latency and case samples. Reports retain their attempts, spend, and effect-state counts. See `implementation/G14.md`.

title: Richer performance statistics
detail: **Implemented.** Reports and comparisons expose p50/p75/p95/p99, mean and dispersion, retry-inclusive latency, successful-request throughput, and distinct warmup measurements; incomplete timing and unknown phase attribution stay explicit. See implementation/G15.md.

title: Streaming model performance
detail: **Implemented.** Opt-in OpenAI-compatible SSE benchmarking records TTFT, receive-time inter-content-delta intervals, usage-based output tokens/sec, and completion integrity; measured and warmup reports/comparisons expose the summaries. See implementation/G16.md.

title: Segment/slice analysis
detail: **Implemented.** Reports independently summarize application outcomes, latency/streaming, warmups, and metric decisions by group_id or nested case metadata. Output is bounded and respects --no-content; JUnit/SARIF reject the unsupported option. See implementation/G17.md.

title: Dataset utilities and versioned suites
detail: **Implemented.** Validation, candidate review/promotion, episodes, content hashes, schema-aware import, bounded JSONL diff, identity-based deduplication, deterministic grouped splitting, and an immutable named suite catalog now exist. Optional Parquet import requires explicit trust because PyArrow decompresses pages before row-size checks. Suites can be listed, verified, and pinned to runs by `NAME@VERSION`. See implementation/G18-import.md, implementation/G18-diff.md, implementation/G18-dedup.md, implementation/G18-split.md, and implementation/G18-suites.md.

title: Workspace maintenance and portability
detail: **Implemented.** `workspace gc` previews orphan artifacts and requires `--apply`; backup/restore and `workspace repair BACKUP` verify integrity and preserve recoverability; `workspace check` validates database, artifact, frozen-plan, and dataset-suite data; versioned run/session bundles move records across workspaces; retention and usage commands manage storage; and `workspace migrate-paths` previews then rebases workspace-rooted paths after a move. External absolute paths, frozen plan bytes, and immutable run/experiment history are preserved. Migration refuses any frozen-plan application or dataset reference whose resolution would change. See implementation/G19-gc.md, implementation/G19-backup.md, implementation/G19-integrity-check.md, implementation/G19-run-bundles.md, implementation/G19-session-bundles.md, implementation/G19-retention.md, and implementation/G19-path-migration.md.

title: Judge repeat/calibration workflow
detail: **Delivered.** Repeated offline/live calibration uses reviewed labels, isolated plugin workers, explicit policy, bounded invocations and usage accounting. Report v3 also compares identical reviewed image cases across vision-judge bindings; descriptive deltas do not establish provider equivalence. F12 was already delivered.

title: Platform and release confidence
detail: **Implemented.** Hosted run 38145775882 passed all 18 jobs on source commit af918898e8a7d14bff2b861c6b3140d3185844d9: six full suites and six clean-wheel release checks on Windows/Linux/macOS with Python 3.11/3.12, plus six real-package DeepEval/Ragas contract jobs on all three OSes with Python 3.12. Live providers, external pilots, and release authorization remain outside this evidence. See implementation/G21-platform-readiness.md.

title: Advanced scale, load, and modality workflows
detail: **Partial.** G22.1 batches work-item persistence, G22.2 pages scheduler work and recovery, and G22.3 adds authenticated outbound workers that pull invocations from a coordinator API without sharing its SQLite workspace. The coordinator retains run state, budgets, retry decisions, artifact writes, and evaluation. G22.3 requires matching app specs and BenchCraft versions, supports only reset mode `none`, and its saved measurements are one-host only; local CLI-worker evidence now records 27.22 invocations/s at capacity 1 and 72.44 at capacity 4 across 100 calls with a 20 ms HTTP fixture (zero failures), plus seven fixture HTTP 429s out of eight under a 0.01 requests/s quota. These one-host synthetic results do not validate cross-host performance. See [measurement harness](../../../scripts/measure_distributed_workers.py) and [capacity 1](../../engineering/evidence/22/distributed-worker-loopback-capacity-1.json), [capacity 4](../../engineering/evidence/22/distributed-worker-loopback-capacity-4.json), and [rate-limit evidence](../../engineering/evidence/22/distributed-worker-loopback-rate-limit.json). A local 1,000-row SQLite insert microbenchmark measured 0.602 s one-at-a-time versus 0.022 s in 500-row batches; compilation and the case map still retain cases in memory. G22.4 implements bounded open-loop/ramping load profiles with dispatch-lag reporting. G22.5 adds isolated image-first `deepeval.vision_g_eval` scoring for text answers using inline PNG/JPEG/WebP images (4 MiB maximum), and G22.8 accepts the same checked image representation as a recorded generated output. G22.5 calibration pairs identical reviewed samples across up to eight provider/model bindings. Reports include decision agreement, scalar score deltas, undecided observations and bounded disagreements; no live provider comparison has been made, and this descriptive output does not establish equivalence. G22.6 adds a loopback-only, read-only dashboard for stored run/session summaries, content-withheld report facts, and explicit stored-run comparisons. An opt-in HTTPS probe is available for an operator-started remote worker, but real cross-host throughput/failure-rate evidence remains pending until a separate host is available; approved live provider calibration and unsupported remote dashboard access also remain limits. G22.9 adds bounded inline WAV/MP3 input and text/audio output scoring through `deepeval.audio_g_eval`; timestamped voice interaction, diarization, video, and DeepEval upstream multimodal metrics remain unsupported. See implementation/G22.1-work-item-batches.md, implementation/G22.2-queue-paging.md, implementation/G22.3-distributed-workers.md, implementation/G22.4-open-loop-ramping.md, implementation/G22.5-image-vision.md, implementation/G22.6-dashboard.md, and implementation/G22.7-remote-worker-probe.md, implementation/G22.8-generated-image-outputs.md, implementation/G22.9-audio-evaluation.md.

title: Whole-workflow cost attribution
detail: **Implemented.** Session-run reports attribute planner usage by source-turn order and provide separate application, primary evaluator-pass, planner, and combined workflow accounting. Workflow totals include all evaluator scoring passes. Unknown or partial usage, canceled calls, concurrent duplicate attempts, and legacy unattributed usage stay explicit; planner dollar pricing remains unknown without provider pricing. See implementation/G23-whole-workflow-cost.md.
